title: Gateway canonical workspace identity contract
contractLabel: DRAFT_CONSUMER_EXPECTATION — a Frontend consumer expectation, UNBOUND to any provider SHA. NOT a canonical contract, NOT live data, grants no authority.
note: This fixture is the machine-readable contract the sibling Gateway session must satisfy. Passing conformance here proves ONLY Frontend shape-compatibility; it does NOT mark the Gateway VERIFIED.

contract.rationale: Workspace identity and capability schema are derived and pinned by the server; the client reads them from GET /api/status and never asserts its own workspace id.
